base:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent pixel fantasy-football die body sprite for a MUTP dice review.
Primary request: Create ONE blank, chunky six-sided cube die, centered and fully visible, with a completely blank large front face for game symbols added separately in the UI. This body will be used for both block dice and a d6. No marks on any face.
Input images: Image 1 (reroll icon) is a material/color style reference only; Image 2 (HUD) is a pixel-art interface style reference only. Generate a new standalone die body, do not edit these references.
Style/medium: hand-painted fantasy pixel-game sprite, crisp stair-stepped edges and connected low-resolution pixel clusters, dark contours, limited palette, readable at 64 pixels. Avoid photographic detail.
Composition: square canvas, one die centered with 12% actual transparent padding. Near-front view: front face is an axis-aligned square occupying approximately x=22% to 73%, y=30% to 81% of canvas. Show only a shallow top face and shallow right face to communicate thickness; do not tilt or rotate the front face. Lighting from upper left. Front center is clean, flat and uncluttered so a symbol overlay remains readable.
Constraints: actual transparent background and preserve alpha; no floor, cast shadow outside object, border, panel, checkerboard, words, letters, numbers, pips, skulls, arrows, symbols, logos or watermark. Exactly one blank die.
